_backup_note: SyncView TikTok Upload — Submit (Direct) (workflow id qGJ7mUjml98DSiGo). Captured 2026-09-08 AFTER adding photo-carousel support: Build Upload Row now also accepts body.mediaUrls (a JSON array of Post For Me media URLs) alongside the existing body.mediaUrl string, and Build Post Body maps mediaUrls into a multi-item Post For Me media[] array (photo/carousel post) instead of the single-item array (video post) used when only mediaUrl is present. Additive and backward compatible: a request that sends only mediaUrl behaves identically to the prior 2026-08-18 snapshot. Build Upload Row's TikTok config also gained auto_add_music (defaults true, matching Post For Me's own prior default, so old requests are unaffected). Restoring this file's node definitions reproduces the current live graph, including carousel support; restoring the 2026-08-18 file instead would drop carousel support (mediaUrls) but leaves the video path intact. To restore, re-import this file or roll back to versionId 007328e6-1fb2-4e26-b025-78ac49491812 in the n8n UI. UPDATED 2026-09-08 (same-day second pass): auto_add_music is now attached to _tiktokCfg only when mediaUrls (the carousel branch) is present, not unconditionally — a legacy single-mediaUrl (video) request produces the exact same configuration object as before this feature existed. To restore, re-import this file or roll back to versionId 264ea658-39c2-449c-b215-d7daa08e53ac in the n8n UI.
